description.value: Baoguette Vietnamese Bistro is a sit-down restaurant in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood serving authentic Vietnamese dishes including pho, bánh mì, spring rolls, and vermicelli bowls. The bistro also operates a second location in Richmond, and its playful name nods to the Vietnamese baguette sandwich that anchors the menu.
